description: Tier 3: resources captured for reference and drift detection only. Never deployed from this repo. Each entry lists the stable, non-secret properties to snapshot (JMESPath over `az resource show`).

resources.name: iothub
resources.why: Shared with other devices. A wrong route or endpoint silently stops telemetry reaching the Event Hub.
resources.query: {sku: sku, location: location, tags: tags, minTlsVersion: properties.minTlsVersion, ipFilterRules: properties.ipFilterRules, features: properties.features, routes: properties.routing.routes, fallbackRoute: properties.routing.fallbackRoute, enrichments: properties.routing.enrichments, eventHubEndpoints: properties.routing.endpoints.eventHubs[].{name: name, resourceGroup: resourceGroup, subscriptionId: subscriptionId, authenticationType: authenticationType}, builtInEndpoint: properties.eventHubEndpoints.events.{partitionCount: partitionCount, retentionTimeInDays: retentionTimeInDays}, cloudToDevice: properties.cloudToDevice.{maxDeliveryCount: maxDeliveryCount, defaultTtlAsIso8601: defaultTtlAsIso8601}}

resources.name: dps
resources.why: Its enrollment group key derives device keys; recreating it forces devices to reprovision.
resources.query: {sku: sku, location: location, allocationPolicy: properties.allocationPolicy, linkedHubs: properties.iotHubs[].{name: name, location: location, allocationWeight: allocationWeight}}

resources.name: functionapp-game
resources.why: The game Function App (Flex Consumption). Managed as a whole app, never by template: a Microsoft.Web/sites resource replaces all app settings, including secrets.
resources.query: {kind: kind, location: location, identity: identity.type, httpsOnly: properties.httpsOnly, serverFarmId: properties.serverFarmId, publicNetworkAccess: properties.publicNetworkAccess, functionAppConfig: properties.functionAppConfig}

resources.name: functionapp-legacy
resources.why: The sibling copilot-iot-service Function App (consumption). Owned by that repo.
resources.query: {kind: kind, location: location, identity: identity, httpsOnly: properties.httpsOnly, serverFarmId: properties.serverFarmId, publicNetworkAccess: properties.publicNetworkAccess}

resources.name: plan-game
resources.why: Flex Consumption plan for the game Function App.
resources.query: {sku: sku, kind: kind, location: location, reserved: properties.reserved}

resources.name: plan-legacy
resources.why: Consumption plan for the legacy Function App.
resources.query: {sku: sku, kind: kind, location: location, reserved: properties.reserved}

resources.name: storage-game
resources.why: Backing storage and deployment package store for the game Function App.
resources.query: {sku: sku, kind: kind, location: location, minimumTlsVersion: properties.minimumTlsVersion, allowBlobPublicAccess: properties.allowBlobPublicAccess, allowSharedKeyAccess: properties.allowSharedKeyAccess, supportsHttpsTrafficOnly: properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly, defaultAction: properties.networkAcls.defaultAction}

resources.name: storage-legacy
resources.why: Backing storage for the legacy Function App.
resources.query: {sku: sku, kind: kind, location: location, minimumTlsVersion: properties.minimumTlsVersion, allowBlobPublicAccess: properties.allowBlobPublicAccess, allowSharedKeyAccess: properties.allowSharedKeyAccess, supportsHttpsTrafficOnly: properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly, defaultAction: properties.networkAcls.defaultAction}

resources.name: appinsights-game
resources.why: Telemetry for the game Function App.
resources.query: {kind: kind, location: location, applicationType: properties.Application_Type, retentionInDays: properties.RetentionInDays, ingestionMode: properties.IngestionMode}

resources.name: appinsights-legacy
resources.why: Telemetry for the legacy Function App.
resources.query: {kind: kind, location: location, applicationType: properties.Application_Type, retentionInDays: properties.RetentionInDays, ingestionMode: properties.IngestionMode}
